SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3 FROM KEP.ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'VERIFY' AND TARGET = 'ILSH' AND KEY_10 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DOC_NAME ,TARGET ,KEY_1 ,KEY_2 ,KEY_3 ,KEY_4 ,KEY_5 ,KEY_6 ,KEY_7 ,KEY_8 FROM KEP.ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
UPDATE KEP.ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
UPDATE KEP.ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
